Aditya Birla Group plans ₹12,000 crore expansion for Odisha alumina refinery

The Aditya Birla Group has proposed an investment of ₹12,000 crore to expand its alumina refinery in Kansariguda, Odisha. This expansion is in addition to an ongoing ₹8,000 crore greenfield project at the same location. The company already operates a refinery and two smelter plants in the state.
